finding_status.notes: codemie.cmd lines 7-14: if-not-exist guards for node.exe and CLI JS entry-point added before invocation; opaque OS error replaced with actionable stderr message
config_path() at codemie_config.rs:98-100 now uses .or_else(|_| std::env::var("USERPROFILE")).unwrap_or_default(); comment documents Windows rationale
downloader.rs:80-96: MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES = 512 MB hard cap; pre-allocation bounded by .min(cap); per-chunk abort when bytes.len() + chunk.len() > cap prevents unbounded heap accumulation
detect_handshake_state accepts injectable version_cmd closure; test global_version_populated_via_injectable_version_cmd at handshake.rs:139 asserts global_version = Some("2.0.1")
spawn_pty checks guard.is_some() at pty.rs:111 and returns Err(InstallerError::Pty("PTY already active")) before overwriting the occupied slot
self_update_direct at runner.rs:149-156 wraps output() with tokio::time::timeout(Duration::from_secs(120)); timeout maps to InstallerError::Other("self-update timed out after 120 s")
tauri.conf.json resources contains only cli/node_modules; node.exe and codemie.cmd moved to tauri.windows.conf.json, restricting Windows-only artifacts to NSIS target
renderer.js:608 safe set updated to new Set(['2.3.3','2.3.5','2.4']); zero-step guard at line 610 emits PROBE_ERR and exits instead of running engine with empty step list
git filter-branch command exited 0; both command records carry head 0b5b0b73 matching current HEAD; no artifact signatures to verify
